about: Content hashes of ten retained article-derived exemplars and one separate invented mechanical fixture. The synthetic fixture is not an accepted article or scientific result.
source: Article-derived hashes and acts are retained verbatim; the synthetic switch-and-bin fixture is project-authored.

imprinting-maternal-offspring-coadaptati.note: The bytes accepted by that act, version 1, now superseded. Version 2 is beside it as `imprinting-maternal-offspring-coadaptation-v2`: both are in the set on purpose, because the guard exists so that an accepted version number is not reused over other content, and that is as true of a superseded version as of the live one.

Accepted and superseded. All three accepted versions of this card are in the set: the guard exists so that an accepted version number is not reused over other content, and that holds for every version an act accepted, not only the live one.

The live card, and the first built with a released kit: version 3 is version 2 rebuilt on ohf-extractor 0.9.0, with the kit pin, the version members and the stamps as the only fields that moved. One content this set must never hold is sha256:1e0f7a82d9ad9b86f259025344aae14259d3c4e3593520133cee0fbb7ea86a1c: no act accepted it, and a later reader must not find it pinned here as though one had.
